Add the speaker's age at the time of each turn

Source: R/context-join.R
add_age.Rd

Adds age_at_time, the speaker's age in whole years on the sitting date of each turn, from the v_age_at_time view. It is NA where the date of birth is not recorded.

Usage

add_age(x)

Arguments

x

Turns: a data frame or tibble with a character action_id column, or a lazy table on the package connection (see the Input and output section).

Value

x with age_at_time added: a tibble for a data frame, a lazy table for a lazy table.

Input and output

x is a result with one row per turn and a character action_id column, such as the output of get_speeches(), search_speeches_by_terms() or get_sitting_timeline(). It is either a data frame (or tibble), or a lazy table on the package connection, such as one returned with collect = FALSE.

  • A lazy table gets a lazy left join, and nothing is read until you collect() it.

  • A data frame is joined inside DuckDB and returned as a tibble, with the same rows in the same order, its columns first and the added columns after them.

Rows are never dropped or repeated. A turn without a PHID (a presiding officer, or a speaker who is not one member; see get_speeches()), or whose action_id is not in the database, is kept with NA in the added columns. A column that is already in x is not added again: only the missing ones are added, and a message names the ones skipped. If all of them are present, x is returned unchanged.

See also

add_member()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
#> Installing the DuckDB fts extension (one-time, needs network).
add_age(get_speeches(from = 2002, to = 2002, include_text = FALSE, limit = 5))
#> # A tibble: 5 × 19
#>   action_id      sitting_id date       chamber chamber_venue parliament_id PHID 
#>   <chr>          <chr>      <date>     <chr>           <int>         <int> <chr>
#> 1 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 SU5  
#> 2 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 K26  
#> 3 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 9V5  
#> 4 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 9V5  
#> 5 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 009CW
#> # ℹ 12 more variables: name_raw <chr>, party_id_at_time <int>,
#> #   party_at_time <chr>, is_speech <lgl>, is_question <lgl>, is_answer <lgl>,
#> #   is_interjection <lgl>, is_non_speech <lgl>, is_petition <lgl>,
#> #   is_motion_no_speech <lgl>, has_quote <lgl>, age_at_time <dbl>
db_disconnect()
